text:
Priya S: Heads-up from the account exec — Meridian wants a migration plan that preserves streaming behavior, rate-limit semantics, and a pricing guarantee for the POC. Can we outline the technical checks and ask items?
Mark D: I'll take streaming. Their current vendor sends chunked SSE with event: partial + seq fields; we need to reassemble chunks and surface a unified streaming API. Tests: out-of-order chunks, dropped chunk resume, and heartbeat handling.
Alex R: For pricing, sales asked for a capped per-POC invoice. They think their monthly unit counts will map to our per-token model; we should provide a conservative conversion and a temporary credit if actual usage spikes during testing.
Ellen Q: Legal flagged two contract asks: (1) limited liability for POC data retention, (2) explicit clause on billing meter during synthetic perf tests. I'll ask Legal to produce a short addendum.
Mark D: Streaming shim notes: our runtime uses chunks with offsets in header X-Chunk-Idx. Meridian uses seq in body. We'll implement a proxy that maps seq->idx and emits SSE event types our SDK expects. Also include a small retry backoff on missing seq.
Priya S: Good. Also they rely on a per-account rate-limit token bucket and surface 429 with Retry-After. Our default backpressure strategy is queue+drop; need to ensure 429 parity for client behavior. Ops, can we mimic 429 for surrogate errors?
OpsBot: Verified: we can configure the proxy to translate internal queue drops into 429 + Retry-After and to honor upstream Retry-After headers. Will need a config flag per-customer.
Alex R: Actionable POC success criteria (proposed): 1) parity for 50 representative prompts (semantic sim > 0.88), 2) streaming fidelity (no <1% chunk loss after reassembly), 3) latency within 1.5x of current vendor at 95th pct, 4) clear billing template and one-month capped exposure.
Ellen Q: Meridian also sent a security questionnaire with KMS/SCIM/SSO questions. We can answer KMS via Dedicated or Private; SCIM is supported, SSO via SAML/OIDC. LegalBot, please attach SOC2 cert and encryption statements.
LegalBot: Uploaded SOC2 report redacted summary and KMS integration notes to https://redwood.internal/prospects/meridian/docs. Also added a draft POC addendum addressing billing and data retention.
Mark D: For tests, I'll produce a small harness that replays recorded SSE streams (including out-of-order/dropped chunks) against our proxy and their reference endpoint. Will log reassembly times and compare final payloads.
Priya S: Perf testing: we need to emulate their peak burst: 250 rps sustained, spikes to 1k for 10s. Can we run this in our staging infra without affecting other tenants?
OpsBot: We can run in an isolated dedicated pool in staging. Need IP allowlist for Meridian to call the proxy endpoints — please provide CIDR ranges.
Alex R: Sales will ask Meridian to sign the POC NDA and provide IP ranges + sample API keys. Jen will coordinate but for our sync assume NDA will land before Monday.
Ellen Q: One more ask — they want logs for the POC (request_id, seq/idx mapping, latency) for three weeks. We'll provide aggregated logs and redacted payloads; raw data will require Private deployment. Flagging for compliance.
Priya S: Cool. Summary of owners: Mark = streaming adapter + harness, Priya = success metrics + data collection, Alex = pricing template + customer comms, Ellen = legal/security + questionnaire answers. We'll reconvene Friday AM to review harness results.
Alex R: Thanks team — prioritize chunk reassembly tests and a simple billing calc for the POC credit. If anything blocks, ping me and @ellenq for rapid signoff.
